major_events: In [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第1章 苏铭], Su Ming is introduced as a Wushan tribe youth who lacks a Barbarian body but reads a leather book and dreams of the cultivation world.
In [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第10章 血燃], Su Ming goes to the fire basin and punctures a strange red tree with a bone horn to save Bai Ling, observing how the cold-natured Moon Wings are affected by heat.
In [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第15章 阿公], Su Ming returns to Wushan and discusses Barbarian symbols and the possibility of cultivation with his grandfather Mo Sang.
In [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第24章 她叫白灵], Su Ming talks with Bai Ling, developing a deeper personal relationship and sharing secrets of their lives.
In [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第30章 彼苍天者，尔独何泣], Su Ming contemplates the desolate history of the Barbarian race, murmuring ancient poetry in deep sorrow.
In [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第41章 欠债还钱], Su Ming goes to the Wind Ridge tribe to sell his refined medicines and collect payments, demonstrating his business-like caution and survival skills.
In [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第61章 解开发绳！], during the Wind Ridge Selection trial, Su Ming decides to unleash his hidden potential by untying his hairband, preparing for a breakthrough on the ranking board.
In [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第83章 风圳山之变！], Heishan tribe launches a sudden attack on Wind Ridge and Wushan tribes, causing massive chaos and initiating a bloody war.
In [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第91章 黑山毕图！], Su Ming participates in the Wushan tribe's tragic migration and reflects on his loss of innocence amidst Heishan's brutal chase.
In [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第104、105章 踏月而战！], Su Ming uses his unique connection with the Moon Wings to obtain power and fights Heishan Bi Tu to assist his grandfather Mo Sang.
In [第二卷 风起天寒 第112章 雷击木生火], Su Ming wakes up in Nanchen with severe injuries, using lightning-struck wood to build a fire and refine medicine to restore his strength.
In [第二卷 风起天寒 第123章 来自安东族长的礼物], Su Ming returns to his hidden cave, analyzes his progress in refining medicine, and plans to join the Andong tribe as a guest cultivator.
In [第二卷 风起天寒 第133章 学诈], Su Ming uses his Dream-like red grass illusion and his Slash Three Pranas (斩三煞) technique to ambush and defeat Han Fei Zi in a cave.
In [第二卷 风起天寒 第153章 墨苏大人], Su Ming travels with Dongfang Hua and encounters the iron-like guard Chou Nu, introducing himself as Andong guest cultivator Mo Su.

In [第二卷 风起天寒 第163章 若不死，则造化], Su Ming faces the remnant soul of Hanshan Ancestor (Han Kong), who attempts to take over his body (夺舍), and Su Ming intentionally allows it to investigate his lost memories.
In [第二卷 风起天寒 第173章 欲鸣惊人！], Su Ming walks through the rain in Hanshan City to participate in the Hanshan Chain challenge to achieve a breakthrough and shock the city.
In [第二卷 风起天寒 第193章 开尘！！], Su Ming uses lightning and his refined medicine to trigger a breakthrough, successfully entering the Dust Opening Stage (开尘境).
In [第二卷 风起天寒 第203章 苏铭的纹！], Su Ming rejects standard Barbarian tattoos like fire moon and cold snow, and instead visualizes his own customized Wushan Barbarian tattoo.
In [第二卷 风起天寒 第221章 家……], Su Ming arrives at the Ninth Peak of Tianhan Sect and feels a sense of belonging in his simple cave, reflecting on his master's advice.
In [第二卷 风起天寒 第233章 你，叫做什么名字……], Sima Xin returns to the Tianhan Sect amidst a spectacular seven-colored light display, attracting the attention of all disciples, while Su Ming watches.
character_state_transitions: Su Ming: A powerless orphan who believes he has no Barbarian body in [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第1章 苏铭] -> An active Blood Condensation cultivator refining mysterious medicinal pills and obtaining bloodlines in [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第6章 恩泽].

Su Ming: A low-profile youth hiding his power under the alias 'Mo Su' in [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第44章 你就是苏铭？] -> A famous cultivator who climbs the Mind Refining Steps and competes with Ye Wang in [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第65章 这是决战！].

Su Ming: A member of a warm tribe who enjoys peace and possesses youthful innocence in [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第45章 那一年的十六岁] -> A silent, battle-hardened survivor who has lost his home and learned to hide his tears in [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第91章 黑山毕图！].

Su Ming: A Blood Condensation stage cultivator struggling to recover his strength in Nanchen in [第二卷 风起天寒 第112章 雷击木生火] -> A Dust Opening Stage (开尘境) powerhouse who commands his own path and defines his own destiny in [第二卷 风起天寒 第193章 开尘！！].

Su Ming: A cultivator without his own Barbarian tattoo who struggles with his identity in [第二卷 风起天寒 第203章 苏铭的纹！] -> A true Barbarian warrior whose soul and body are tattooed with the image of Wushan (乌山) in [第二卷 风起天寒 第210章 此山，名乌！].

Bai Ling: A girl captured by a strange tree and crying in despair in [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第10章 血燃] -> A quiet girl who observes the Wind Ridge selection and remembers Su Ming's rescue in [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第61章 解开发绳！].

Lei Chen: Su Ming's honest and simple childhood friend in Wushan in [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第20章 寒酸] -> A tragic figure caught in Heishan's invasion who makes a difficult choice during the tribe's escape in [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第98章 雷辰的抉择！].

He Feng: An arrogant guest cultivator of Hanshan City who plots against Su Ming in [第二卷 风起天寒 第120章 和风] -> A captive spirit refined by Su Ming to serve as his submissive helper and informant in [第二卷 风起天寒 第126章 最后一个问题].

Han Fei Zi: A cold and aloof female cultivator of Hanshan City who seeks her own benefits in [第二卷 风起天寒 第121章 寒菲子] -> A defeated, wary opponent who realizes she cannot look down on Su Ming in [第二卷 风起天寒 第133章 学诈].

Shan Hen: A respected Wushan tribe warrior who is trusted by his people in [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第8章 红泥] -> A revealed traitor who collaborated with Heishan and dies with an infant leg bone in his hand, leaving Su Ming with deep questions in [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第103章 最接近天的地方].

Tian Xie Zi: An eccentric and legendary elder who seems erratic and unpredictable in [第二卷 风起天寒 第200章 天邪子] -> A caring master who guides Su Ming to find his own quiet path and realize the nature of 'creation' in [第二卷 风起天寒 第222章 何为造化].

long_form_mechanisms.name: The Barbarian Body and Bloodlines (蛮体与血线)
long_form_mechanisms.description: The basic cultivation system of the Barbarian race. Cultivators in the Blood Condensation Stage (凝血境) must refine their blood and condense bloodlines. The more bloodlines they condense (up to 999), the stronger they are and the higher their chance of reaching the Dust Opening Stage. [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第5章 梦呢]

long_form_mechanisms.name: Medicine Refinement (淬散/淬制药石)
long_form_mechanisms.description: The process of refining raw herbs into medicinal powders (like 清尘散, 南离散, 山灵散) using fire, specific tools, and techniques. The protagonist uses a mysterious green stone bead to enter a dream-like state (Desolate Tripod) to achieve perfect purity in refinement. [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第9章 淬散]

long_form_mechanisms.name: The Desolate Stone Bead (梦中荒鼎)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A mysterious green bead that Su Ming drops his blood on. It allows him to enter a dream space (called 荒 / Desolate), where time flows differently and he can practice refining herbs without wasting real-world resources. [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第5章 梦呢]

long_form_mechanisms.name: The Moon Wings and Blood Moon (月翼与血月)
long_form_mechanisms.description: Moon Wings are mysterious cold-based creatures that live in Wushan. Under the blood moon, they go into a frenzy. Su Ming possesses a unique connection to them, allowing him to command them and absorb their cold energy to boost his strength. [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第10章 血燃]

long_form_mechanisms.name: Wind Ridge Mind-Refining Steps (风圳山心炼之阶)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A set of stone stairs on Wind Ridge mountain that exerts massive pressure on anyone who climbs them. It tests a cultivator's cultivation level, willpower, and heart. The further one climbs, the greater the resistance and danger. [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第63章 心炼之阶]

long_form_mechanisms.name: Soul Takeover (夺舍)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A forbidden technique where a cultivator's soul enters another person's body to take control of it, erasing or suppressing the original soul. During the process, the soul can read the host's memories, but it carries a risk of backlash. [第二卷 风起天寒 第163章 若不死，则造化]

long_form_mechanisms.name: Slash Three Pranas (斩三煞)
long_form_mechanisms.description: A powerful, invisible Barbarian technique where the cultivator uses their bloodlines and focus to strike the enemy's vital points (the three pranas). It requires precise target positioning and leaves no physical trace. [第二卷 风起天寒 第133章 学诈]

long_form_mechanisms.name: Barbarian Tattoos (蛮纹)
long_form_mechanisms.description: Tattoos that represent a Barbarian cultivator's soul, beliefs, and memories, which they must visualize and draw on their body to complete the breakthrough to the Dust Opening Stage. A cultivator's future potential is heavily determined by their chosen tattoo. [第二卷 风起天寒 第203章 苏铭的纹！]

long_form_mechanisms.name: Hanshan Chains (邯山链)
long_form_mechanisms.description: Massive iron chains suspended between the mountains of Hanshan City. They are enchanted with powerful restrictions and pressure, serving as a trial for guest cultivators to prove their strength and earn the right to enter higher levels of the city. [第二卷 风起天寒 第172章 雨中邯山链]

continuity_observations: The mystery of Su Ming's lack of a Barbarian body in Wushan is introduced in [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第1章 苏铭] and remains a core mystery until it is revealed that Wushan itself might be an illusion or a seal during the transition to Nanchen.

The green stone bead remains Su Ming's primary cheat, starting as a mysterious item in [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第4章 异变] and evolving into the Desolate Tripod space which he relies on to refine advanced pills like 夺灵散 in Nanchen in [第二卷 风起天寒 第123章 来自安东族长的礼物].

The theme of memory loss and illusion is hinted at in [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第30章 彼苍天者，尔独何泣] and becomes a central plot point in Nanchen when Su Ming encounters Hanshan Ancestor and discovers his memories of Wushan might have been altered or constructed in [第二卷 风起天寒 第163章 若不死，则造化].

The name 'Mo Su' (墨苏) is first used as a disguise by Su Ming during the Wind Ridge selection in [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第61章 解开发绳！], and is consistently maintained as his public alias when he enters Hanshan City to hide his identity from his enemies in [第二卷 风起天寒 第153章 墨苏大人].

The connection to the Moon Wings, first discovered by Su Ming in the fire basin in [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第10章 血燃], is later utilized in his desperate battle against Bi Tu in [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第104、105章 踏月而战！], and remains a secret weapon in Nanchen.

The character Sima Xin is established as a major future antagonist when Su Ming hears about his snow tattoo in [第二卷 风起天寒 第203章 苏铭的纹！], leading up to Sima Xin's dramatic return in [第二卷 风起天寒 第233章 你，叫做什么名字……].

The character Lei Chen, who is separated from Su Ming during Heishan's invasion in [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第98章 雷辰的抉择！], is later seen or referenced in Nanchen as a member of another faction, maintaining their tragic connection in [第二卷 风起天寒 第181章 雷辰！！].

The image of the Wushan mountain range represents Su Ming's home and longing, starting as a real physical place in Volume 1, and eventually becoming his unique Barbarian tattoo in Volume 2, showing his refusal to forget his roots in [第二卷 风起天寒 第210章 此山，名乌！].

The character Han Fei Zi is introduced as a cold competitor in Hanshan City in [第二卷 风起天寒 第121章 寒菲子], becomes a defeated rival in [第二卷 风起天寒 第133章 学诈], and is later revealed to have successfully joined the Tianhan Sect, crossing paths with Su Ming again in [第二卷 风起天寒 第216章 天岚壁障！].
style_observations: Melancholic and Philosophical Tone: Unlike typical power-fantasy Xianxia novels, Er Gen's writing in 《求魔》 is deeply melancholic, focusing on themes of loneliness, destiny, and the tragic nature of truth and illusion. [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第32章 年华里谁在叹息……], [第二卷 风起天寒 第202章 原来，是我在叹息……]

Detailed and Ritualistic Pill Refining: The author describes the processes of herb refining, temperature control, and pill ingestion with great detail, making the alchemy system feel tactile and systematic rather than a simple plot device. [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第9章 淬散], [第二卷 风起天寒 第112章 雷击木生火]

Symbolic and Emotional Combat: Fights are often resolved not just by raw power, but through emotional resonance, willpower, or the symbolic weight of one's background, such as Su Ming using the Moon Wings or visualising Wushan. [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第104、105章 踏月而战！], [第二卷 风起天寒 第210章 此山，名乌！]

Slow-paced character development: The protagonist's growth is marked by psychological trauma and loss rather than quick victories, with a transition from a smiling boy to a silent man. [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第91章 黑山毕图！]

Complex Narrative Mystery and Suspense: The plot leaves numerous unanswered questions and uses distorted memories or mysterious dialogue to keep the reader guessing about the nature of the protagonist's reality. [第二卷 风起天寒 第143章 我忘了什么……], [第二卷 风起天寒 第163章 若不死，则造化]

Contrast between Cluttered Sects and Quiet Solitude: The narrative structures Nanchen and Hanshan City as bustling, competitive, and cold places, which contrasts sharply with Su Ming's quiet, solitary cultivate style in his caves or on the Ninth Peak. [第二卷 风起天寒 第118章 邯山城], [第二卷 风起天寒 第221章 家……]

Visual and Spatial Metaphors for Progress: Power progression is mapped to physical obstacles, such as climbing the steps of Wind Ridge mountain or traversing the suspended Hanshan Chains. [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第63章 心炼之阶], [第二卷 风起天寒 第172章 雨中邯山链]

creation_family_evidence.author: 耳根 (Er Gen)
creation_family_evidence.stylistic_signature: Features a highly melancholic, destiny-focused, and atmospheric narrative with an emphasis on philosophical concepts of fate, memory, and illusion. Typical of Er Gen's works, it features detailed alchemical pill refinement and unique, custom power progressions (such as Su Ming defining his own Wushan Barbarian tattoo) rather than standard power systems.
creation_family_evidence.compilation_indicators: The chapter headers are formatted as '第一卷 人生若只如初见 第10章 血燃' or '第二卷 风起天寒 第223章 三师兄的怪癖', indicating a structured serialization into volumes and chapters. The use of double-byte full-width spaces at paragraph starts (e.g., '\u3000\u3000') represents standard Chinese web novel serializations and compiled text editions.

originality_risks: The mysterious cheat item trope: The protagonist starts as an underdog who cannot cultivate but receives a mysterious stone bead (the Desolate Tripod bead) that allows him to excel in medicine refinement and catch up with geniuses, which is a highly common trope in Xianxia novels. [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第4章 异变]

The alias 'Mo Su' and hidden identity: The protagonist adopting a mysterious mask and a cool name to participate in public events and shock onlookers while hiding his weak or targeted true identity is a standard plot device used to build dramatic tension. [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第61章 解开发绳！], [第二卷 风起天寒 第153章 墨苏大人]

Clan/Tribe invasion and migration: The tragic destruction of the protagonist's home tribe (Wushan) and the subsequent migration and chase by a more powerful enemy (Heishan) serves as a common early-stage motivation driver in cultivation stories. [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第83章 风圳山之变！], [第一卷 人生若只如初见 第91章 黑山毕图！]

The eccentric master and isolated peak: Joining a major sect (Tianhan Sect) but being recruited by a weird, powerful master (Tian Xie Zi) who lives on a lonely peak (the Ninth Peak) with a few strange senior brothers is a repetitive template seen in many Xianxia novels (e.g. Zhu Xian's Bamboo Peak). [第二卷 风起天寒 第219章 第九峰], [第二卷 风起天寒 第223章 三师兄的怪癖]

The arrogant rival: The introduction of a supreme genius disciple (Sima Xin) who is praised by everyone and has a similar power set but behaves arrogantly, setting up an inevitable future confrontation with the protagonist, is a standard narrative setup. [第二卷 风起天寒 第203章 苏铭的纹！], [第二卷 风起天寒 第233章 你，叫做什么名字……]
